name: Gitea / Forgejo
description: Your Gitea or Forgejo work in lanes: pull requests waiting for your review, what happens on your own PRs, issues assigned to or mentioning you, and your failed CI runs, with unread marks and Discuss with Claude. Signs in with a server address and an access token. Writes only to mark the server's notifications read and, where the server can, to re-run failed jobs. Provides an inbox-feed for Inbox.
author: Oleg Bronzov

serverUrl.title: Server address
serverUrl.description: Your Gitea or Forgejo server, such as https://git.example.com (with its path, if it lives under one). https only; http only for localhost.

token.title: Access token
token.description: A personal access token from the server (Settings > Applications) with read:issue, read:repository, read:organization, read:notification and write:notification. Kept in the system keychain.

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Which lanes to show. A hidden lane is not fetched and its items never reach Inbox.

issues.title: Issues (assigned to me or mentioning me)

myIssues.title: Also issues I opened
myIssues.description: Add the open issues you opened to the Issues lane, even when nobody assigned them to you.

rowsPerLane.title: Items per lane
rowsPerLane.description: How many items a lane shows; the rest are behind Show all at the bottom of the lane.

markReadOnOpen.title: Mark an item read when I open it
markReadOnOpen.description: On: opening an item (here or from Inbox) marks it read. Off: it stays unread until you press Mark read.

exclude.title: Leave out
exclude.description: Owners (acme) or repositories (acme/widgets) whose items are not shown, any letter case.

pollMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: Pull requests and issues; failed runs are checked every 5 minutes at most. Only while this project's window is open.
